messages:
maya (eng-platform): Heads-up — planning a short activation window for the allowlist flag for AlderTech (enterprise). Flag: ft_allow_VIP_AlderTech. Window: 2024-06-15 22:00-22:30 UTC. Canary audience: 5% of AlderTech accounts (account_id hash). Rollback plan ready. Code review + infra prechecks passed. Need ops coverage and perf monitoring. Details below.

sam (eng-runtime): quick q — org-level allowlist or per-account override? also any token limits for the canary?

maya (eng-platform): org-level allowlist keyed by external_account_id. No extra token limits beyond standard rate limits; AlderTech has burst uplift in contract but we keep a soft cap for the canary. rollout config snippet:

```json
{"flag": "ft_allow_VIP_AlderTech", "rules": [{"if": "contract_tag == \"v3\" && account_hash < 0.05", "then": "enable"}], "fallback": "baseline-model"}
```

dan (sre): I'll be oncall. I'll attach latency + error SLO dashboards and set short-term alerts. Which alerts do you want as a hard stop?

maya (eng-platform): hard-stop alerts: 5xx rate > 1% over 5m, p50 latency +200ms over baseline, token cost per request > +20% vs baseline. Will post datadog links in a follow-up.

carla (product): +1 from PM. Confirming we gate by contract v3 only? AlderTech has staged customers on v2/v3.

maya (eng-platform): yes, gating by contract_tag == \"v3\". Others fall back to baseline routing. If we see unexpected traffic from non-v3 accounts, we roll back.

ops-bot: Deployment scheduled: infra-deploy/ft-allow-VIP-AlderTech at 2024-06-15T22:00:00Z by maya. CID: deploy-7312.

leo (eng-oncall): I'll execute the canary ramp: 0% -> 1% -> 5% over first 10 minutes, watch traces and heatmaps. Ping me 10m before start.

sam (eng-runtime): noted :thumbsup: I'll also keep an eye on kv-cache hit rate — new routing may change patterns.

maya (eng-platform): rollback command if needed: `/run rollback ft_allow_VIP_AlderTech --to=off`\.
If we need a partial rollback, we can flip the org rule to 0.5% and re-evaluate. Last call for objections; otherwise proceed with scheduled window.

carla (product): thanks, will coordinate CS and let AlderTech know the short window and expected behavior.

maya (eng-platform): thanks all — I'll post the datadog dashboards + postmortem template after the window.
